csv_project_name: Developer for CCHA Affordable Housing Development
csv_scope_of_work: CCHA Affordable Housing Development Opportunities The Cameron County Housing Authority CCHA and its public facility corporation affiliate, the Community Housing & Economic Development Corporation CHEDC, invite proposals and letters of interest from qualified developers, investors, and housing organizations to partner with CCHA in acquiring, constructing, rehabilitating, or financing affordable residential housing in Cameron County, Texas but outside of Brownsville. CCHA will consider a broad range of development concepts including new construction, acquisition/rehabilitation, mixed-income and mixed-use projects, LIHTC deals, HUD repositioning programs, PFC structures, workforce housing, and innovative housing models on CCHA-owned land or other sites.
